{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''The Charge at Feather Nebula''''' was a [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] that was released sometime after the actual [[Battle of the Feather Nebula]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Reconquest of the Rim|reconquest]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The holodrama's title refers to the real-world 1953 western film [[Wikipedia:The Charge at Feather River|''The Charge at Feather River'']], which contains the original [[Wilhelm scream]]. In his endnotes for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', [[Jason Fry]], one of the authors of the book, implies that the holodrama also used the Wilhelm scream by saying, "If you know your [[Ben Burtt]] lore, I bet you can guess what sound is heard at least once during ''The Charge at Feather Nebula".''<ref name="JLT">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>
